---
name: SDLC Documentation Evidence
description: Keep SDLC documentation factual, traceable, and synchronized with approved project state.
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md"
---
# SDLC Documentation Instructions

- Preserve stable requirement, ADR, task, test, and decision identifiers.
- Separate verified facts from assumptions and recommendations.
- Do not rewrite historical decisions; supersede them explicitly.
- Do not record an approval unless a human explicitly provided it.
- Use exact command/results evidence for test and quality claims.
- Keep traceability links current when requirements, architecture, tasks, or tests change.
